sections.A: Asthma mein saans ki naliyon mein lambi sozish hoti hai aur hawa ka rasta kabhi tang aur kabhi khula hota hai. Dhool, thand ya exercise jaise triggers ise barhate hain.
sections.B: Wheeze, seene mein jakran, saans phoolna aur khansi (aksar raat ko), exercise ya triggers par.
sections.C: Triggers, raat ko jagna, neela inhaler kitni baar, preventer ka istemal aur pehle shadeed attack.
sections.D: Peak flow ko patient ki apni behtareen value se milayein, aur Asthma Control Test.
sections.G: Poora jumla na bol sakna, saans aur dhadkan bohat tez, peak flow 33-50%: acute severe attack. Khamosh seena: jaan lewa, emergency.
sections.H: Attack ho to emergency. Control mein ho to exercise training aur zaroorat ho to breathing retraining.
sections.I: Breathing retraining: naak se saans, aahista aur halki saans, aur exercise ka sahi warm-up.
sections.M: Asthma Control Test, peak flow diary, exercise ki bardasht aur Nijmegen score.
sections.N: Sawaal hal karein. Khamosh seena (silent chest) ka matlab bohat shadeed rukawat hai.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
